title: Mt Fuji, Lakeside Walks & Private Onsen
description: Leave Tokyo for the Fuji Five Lakes — Japan's most iconic mountain over mirror-still lakes. Overnight in Kawaguchiko combines Mt Fuji views and private onsen while saving vs Tokyo hotel prices. Relaxed pace: nature, hot springs, jaw-dropping scenery.

activities.title: Shinjuku → Kawaguchiko (Highway Bus)
activities.description: Fuji Kyuko highway bus from Busta Shinjuku (4F) direct to Kawaguchiko in ~2 hours. Book via highway-buses.jp — Golden Week buses fill up!
details: 🎫 Book 3-4 days ahead for Golden Week
💡 Sit LEFT side for first Fuji glimpse

activities.title: Kawaguchiko North Shore Walk
activities.description: Drop bags at ryokan, walk the north shore. Ohashi bridge frames Fuji perfectly. Follow the lakeside promenade for iconic angles.
details: 📷 Best reflections: early morning or late afternoon

meals.name: Konbini at Busta Shinjuku
meals.description: Onigiri, fruit, coffee before the bus.

tips.text: 🏔️ Fuji visibility: Mornings clearer than afternoons. Clouds roll in after 13:00. Plan Fuji moments before lunch.

activities.title: Oshino Hakkai — Sacred Spring Village
activities.description: Traditional village with eight crystal-clear spring ponds fed by Fuji snowmelt filtered through lava for 80 years. Thatched-roof farmhouses against Fuji. Most tourists skip this gem.
details: 📷 Waku Pond Fuji reflection is iconic
🍡 Try grilled mochi — ask niku nashi

activities.title: Private Onsen Experience
activities.description: Check into ryokan for private onsen (kashikiri buro). Many offer private baths by the hour with Fuji views. Budget: K's House Mt Fuji (hostel + onsen, ¥4,000/person) or Fuji Tominoko Hotel (from ¥9,000/room).
details: 💡 Onsen etiquette: shower first, no swimwear

meals.name: Hōtō Noodles — Kawaguchiko
meals.description: Local Yamanashi specialty: thick flat udon in miso vegetable stew with pumpkin, mushrooms, root veg. Ask niku nashi. Hōtō Fudō near the station is most famous.

meals.name: Ryokan Dinner
meals.description: If your ryokan includes dinner, tell them vegetarian when booking — most prepare a vegetable kaiseki. Otherwise: izakaya with edamame, agedashi tofu, yasai tempura, rice.

tips.text: Oshino Hakkai blew my mind — crystal clear water with Fuji in the background. Surreal and nobody told me about it before my trip.
🌅 Set an alarm for sunrise (~5:00 AM) — morning Fuji from the lake with no clouds is unforgettable.

mapPins.desc: Hot spring bath with Mt Fuji views
